# Flare Vault

> Flare Vault is a non-custodial web app for Flare Mainnet (chain ID 14). Users connect their own wallet; the site never asks for or stores a recovery phrase or private key.

## What it does
- Shows FLR and Flare-network token balances for the connected wallet
- Send and receive FLR and tokens
- Staking and the Legacy Vault (plan how assets pass on)

## Key facts
- Website: https://www.flarevaultapp.xyz/
- Network: Flare Mainnet (chain ID 14)
- Custody: non-custodial; all transactions are signed in the user's own wallet
- Support: support@flarevaultapp.xyz
- X: https://x.com/flare_vault

## Notes
- Not financial advice. Crypto carries risk.
